title: First conversations
goal: Say what you need and understand simple requests.

lessons.meaning: A friendly word used when you meet or greet someone.
lessons.example: Say hello to your new classmate.
lessons.tip: Use hello as a greeting, not as a farewell.
lessons.exampleUrdu: اپنے نئے ہم جماعت کو سلام کہیں۔

lessons.meaning: The word or words used to identify a person or thing.
lessons.example: Please write your full name on this form.
lessons.tip: A full name usually includes a given name and a family name.
lessons.exampleUrdu: براہ کرم اس فارم پر اپنا پورا نام لکھیں۔

lessons.meaning: A word that makes a request more polite.
lessons.example: Please help me find the classroom.
lessons.tip: Put please at the beginning or end of a polite request.
lessons.exampleUrdu: براہ کرم کمرۂ جماعت تلاش کرنے میں میری مدد کریں۔

lessons.meaning: To tell someone that you are grateful for something.
lessons.example: I want to thank you for your help.
lessons.tip: Say thank you, or thank someone for something.
lessons.exampleUrdu: میں آپ کی مدد پر آپ کا شکریہ ادا کرنا چاہتا ہوں۔

lessons.meaning: To make it easier for someone to do something.
lessons.example: Can you help me carry this bag?
lessons.tip: Say help someone do something or help someone with something.
lessons.exampleUrdu: کیا آپ یہ بیگ اٹھانے میں میری مدد کر سکتے ہیں؟

lessons.meaning: To require something because it is necessary.
lessons.example: I need help with this question.
lessons.tip: Need describes something necessary; want describes a wish.
lessons.exampleUrdu: اس سوال میں مجھے مدد چاہیے۔

title: People around you
goal: Talk about people and everyday relationships.

lessons.meaning: A person you know well and like spending time with.
lessons.example: My close friend lives near our school.
lessons.tip: A close friend is someone you know particularly well.
lessons.exampleUrdu: میرا قریبی دوست ہمارے اسکول کے قریب رہتا ہے۔

lessons.meaning: A group of people related to one another.
lessons.example: Each family member helped prepare the meal.
lessons.tip: A family can include relatives beyond parents and children.
lessons.exampleUrdu: خاندان کے ہر فرد نے کھانا تیار کرنے میں مدد کی۔

lessons.meaning: A person who lives near you.
lessons.example: Our next-door neighbour watered our plants.
lessons.tip: Neighbour is British spelling; neighbor is American spelling.
lessons.exampleUrdu: ہمارے ساتھ والے پڑوسی نے ہمارے پودوں کو پانی دیا۔

lessons.meaning: A person whose work is to help others learn.
lessons.example: Our English teacher explained the new word.
lessons.tip: Use teach for the action and teacher for the person.
lessons.exampleUrdu: ہمارے انگریزی کے استاد نے نئے لفظ کی وضاحت کی۔

lessons.meaning: A person who is learning at a school, college or other place.
lessons.example: The new student asked where the library was.
lessons.tip: Student can refer to learners of different ages.
lessons.exampleUrdu: نئے طالب علم نے پوچھا کہ کتب خانہ کہاں ہے۔

lessons.meaning: A person invited to visit or stay with someone.
lessons.example: We welcome every guest with a cup of tea.
lessons.tip: A guest is invited; a customer pays for a service.
lessons.exampleUrdu: ہم ہر مہمان کا استقبال چائے کے ایک کپ سے کرتے ہیں۔

title: Everyday actions
goal: Use practical verbs in simple sentences.

lessons.meaning: To say a question or request something from someone.
lessons.example: You can ask a question after the lesson.
lessons.tip: Ask someone a question, or ask for something.
lessons.exampleUrdu: آپ سبق کے بعد سوال پوچھ سکتے ہیں۔

lessons.meaning: To say or write a reply to a question.
lessons.example: Please answer the question in one sentence.
lessons.tip: Say answer the question, without to before question.
lessons.exampleUrdu: براہ کرم سوال کا جواب ایک جملے میں دیں۔

lessons.meaning: To carry something to the place where someone is or will be.
lessons.example: Please bring a notebook to class tomorrow.
lessons.tip: Bring usually means movement towards the speaker or destination.
lessons.exampleUrdu: براہ کرم کل جماعت میں ایک کاپی لائیں۔

lessons.meaning: To go away from a place.
lessons.example: We leave home at eight every morning.
lessons.tip: Say leave a place, without from when naming the place directly.
lessons.exampleUrdu: ہم ہر صبح آٹھ بجے گھر سے روانہ ہوتے ہیں۔

lessons.meaning: To stay until someone arrives or something happens.
lessons.example: Please wait for me outside the school.
lessons.tip: Use wait for a person or thing.
lessons.exampleUrdu: براہ کرم اسکول کے باہر میرا انتظار کریں۔

lessons.meaning: To let another person use or have part of something.
lessons.example: I share my lunch with my friend.
lessons.tip: Use share something with someone.
lessons.exampleUrdu: میں اپنا دوپہر کا کھانا اپنے دوست کے ساتھ بانٹتا ہوں۔

title: Time and routine
goal: Describe when things happen and how long they last.

lessons.meaning: Before the usual or expected time.
lessons.example: We arrive early so we can find our seats.
lessons.tip: Early means before the expected time; soon means after a short time.
lessons.exampleUrdu: ہم جلدی پہنچتے ہیں تاکہ اپنی نشستیں تلاش کر سکیں۔

lessons.meaning: After the usual or expected time.
lessons.example: The bus arrived late because of the rain.
lessons.tip: Late describes timing; lately means recently.
lessons.exampleUrdu: بارش کی وجہ سے بس دیر سے پہنچی۔

lessons.meaning: On most occasions, though not every time.
lessons.example: I usually walk to school with my sister.
lessons.tip: Usually often goes before the main verb.
lessons.exampleUrdu: میں عام طور پر اپنی بہن کے ساتھ پیدل اسکول جاتا ہوں۔

lessons.meaning: On many occasions.
lessons.example: We often visit our grandparents on Sunday.
lessons.tip: Often indicates frequency, not how long a visit lasts.
lessons.exampleUrdu: ہم اکثر اتوار کو اپنے دادا دادی سے ملنے جاتے ہیں۔

lessons.meaning: Earlier than a particular time or event.
lessons.example: I review my notes before class.
lessons.tip: Before can introduce a time, an event or a clause.
lessons.exampleUrdu: میں جماعت شروع ہونے سے پہلے اپنے نوٹس دہراتا ہوں۔

lessons.meaning: Later than a particular time or event.
lessons.example: We practise English after lunch.
lessons.tip: After answers when; afterwards means at a later time.
lessons.exampleUrdu: ہم دوپہر کے کھانے کے بعد انگریزی کی مشق کرتے ہیں۔

title: Places and directions
goal: Find your way and describe familiar places.

lessons.meaning: At a short distance from someone or something.
lessons.example: There is a bus stop near the school.
lessons.tip: Near does not need to before its object.
lessons.exampleUrdu: اسکول کے قریب بس کا ایک اسٹاپ ہے۔

lessons.meaning: In the space separating two people or things.
lessons.example: The shop is between the bank and the school.
lessons.tip: Between can also describe separate relationships among more than two things.
lessons.exampleUrdu: دکان بینک اور اسکول کے درمیان ہے۔

lessons.meaning: Facing someone or something on the other side.
lessons.example: The café is opposite the station.
lessons.tip: Opposite describes location here, not a contrary opinion.
lessons.exampleUrdu: کیفے اسٹیشن کے سامنے ہے۔

lessons.meaning: A door or other place through which you enter.
lessons.example: Meet me at the main entrance of the library.
lessons.tip: Entrance is where you go in; exit is where you go out.
lessons.exampleUrdu: کتب خانے کے مرکزی دروازے پر مجھ سے ملیں۔

lessons.meaning: A place where two sides or streets meet.
lessons.example: Turn left at the next street corner.
lessons.tip: A street corner is a meeting point of streets.
lessons.exampleUrdu: اگلے موڑ پر بائیں مڑیں۔

lessons.meaning: The way in which someone or something moves or points.
lessons.example: Are we walking in the right direction?
lessons.tip: Directions in the plural can mean instructions for finding a place.
lessons.exampleUrdu: کیا ہم درست سمت میں چل رہے ہیں؟

title: Food and daily needs
goal: Talk about food, drinks and simple preferences.

lessons.meaning: Food eaten at a regular time, such as breakfast or dinner.
lessons.example: We eat our evening meal together.
lessons.tip: A meal is an occasion of eating, not a single ingredient.
lessons.exampleUrdu: ہم شام کا کھانا مل کر کھاتے ہیں۔

lessons.meaning: Recently made, grown or obtained and still in good condition.
lessons.example: The bakery sells fresh bread every morning.
lessons.tip: Fresh can describe food that is not old or stale.
lessons.exampleUrdu: بیکری ہر صبح تازہ روٹی فروخت کرتی ہے۔

lessons.meaning: Feeling that you need or want to eat.
lessons.example: I feel hungry after the long walk.
lessons.tip: Say I am hungry or I feel hungry.
lessons.exampleUrdu: طویل پیدل سفر کے بعد مجھے بھوک لگتی ہے۔

lessons.meaning: Feeling that you need or want to drink.
lessons.example: You may feel thirsty after playing outside.
lessons.tip: Thirsty describes a need for a drink, not food.
lessons.exampleUrdu: باہر کھیلنے کے بعد آپ کو پیاس لگ سکتی ہے۔

lessons.meaning: To ask for food or another item to be supplied.
lessons.example: We order a meal at the café.
lessons.tip: In a café, order means request something you will usually pay for.
lessons.exampleUrdu: ہم کیفے میں کھانا منگواتے ہیں۔

lessons.meaning: To like or choose one thing more than another.
lessons.example: I prefer tea to coffee.
lessons.tip: Use prefer one thing to another, rather than than.
lessons.exampleUrdu: میں کافی پر چائے کو ترجیح دیتا ہوں۔

title: Buying and paying
goal: Ask about prices and make practical decisions.

lessons.meaning: The amount of money needed to buy something.
lessons.example: Check the price before you buy the bag.
lessons.tip: Price is what a buyer pays; cost can include production or other expenses.
lessons.exampleUrdu: بیگ خریدنے سے پہلے اس کی قیمت دیکھیں۔

lessons.meaning: Money returned when you pay more than the amount due.
lessons.example: I paid with a large note and received change.
lessons.tip: Change is usually uncountable when it means money returned.
lessons.exampleUrdu: میں نے بڑا نوٹ دیا اور بقایا رقم وصول کی۔

lessons.meaning: A document showing that you have paid for something.
lessons.example: Keep the receipt in case you return the shirt.
lessons.tip: A receipt records payment; a bill usually requests it.
lessons.exampleUrdu: رسید سنبھال کر رکھیں تاکہ ضرورت پڑنے پر قمیص واپس کر سکیں۔

lessons.meaning: To have enough money or time for something.
lessons.example: I cannot afford a ticket for that concert.
lessons.tip: Afford is often used with can or cannot.
lessons.exampleUrdu: اس محفلِ موسیقی کے ٹکٹ کی میرے پاس استطاعت نہیں ہے۔

lessons.meaning: A reduction in the usual price.
lessons.example: The shop offers a discount to students.
lessons.tip: A discount reduces a price; it does not mean an item is free.
lessons.exampleUrdu: دکان طلبہ کو قیمت میں رعایت دیتی ہے۔

lessons.meaning: To take something back to the place where you obtained it.
lessons.example: You can return an item if it is damaged.
lessons.tip: Return an item describes giving it back, not receiving a refund automatically.
lessons.exampleUrdu: اگر چیز خراب ہو تو آپ اسے واپس کر سکتے ہیں۔

title: Travel plans
goal: Plan a journey and respond to changes.

lessons.meaning: An act of travelling from one place to another.
lessons.example: Take some water for the long journey.
lessons.tip: Journey focuses on travel from one place to another.
lessons.exampleUrdu: طویل سفر کے لیے کچھ پانی ساتھ لے لیں۔

lessons.meaning: The place you are travelling to.
lessons.example: We will reach our destination before sunset.
lessons.tip: A destination is an end point, not the route used to reach it.
lessons.exampleUrdu: ہم سورج غروب ہونے سے پہلے اپنی منزل پر پہنچ جائیں گے۔

lessons.meaning: The act or scheduled time of leaving a place.
lessons.example: Check the departure time on your ticket.
lessons.tip: Departure contrasts with arrival.
lessons.exampleUrdu: اپنے ٹکٹ پر روانگی کا وقت دیکھیں۔

lessons.meaning: A period of waiting that makes something happen later than planned.
lessons.example: An unexpected delay made us miss the first lesson.
lessons.tip: Delay may be a noun or a verb.
lessons.exampleUrdu: غیر متوقع تاخیر کی وجہ سے ہمارا پہلا سبق رہ گیا۔

lessons.meaning: To arrange for something to be kept for your later use.
lessons.example: You can reserve a seat online.
lessons.tip: Reserve means arrange in advance; pay if the booking rules require it.
lessons.exampleUrdu: آپ آن لائن نشست محفوظ کرا سکتے ہیں۔

lessons.meaning: The way taken to reach a place.
lessons.example: This map shows a shorter route to the station.
lessons.tip: Route is the way taken; destination is where you are going.
lessons.exampleUrdu: اس نقشے میں اسٹیشن تک جانے کا چھوٹا راستہ دکھایا گیا ہے۔

title: Feelings and support
goal: Describe feelings and respond thoughtfully.

lessons.meaning: Not worried, angry or excited.
lessons.example: Try to stay calm before the interview.
lessons.tip: Calm describes a state; calmly describes how you act.
lessons.exampleUrdu: انٹرویو سے پہلے پرسکون رہنے کی کوشش کریں۔

lessons.meaning: Feeling uneasy because something bad might happen.
lessons.example: I am worried about missing the bus.
lessons.tip: Use worried about a situation, or worried that something may happen.
lessons.exampleUrdu: مجھے بس چھوٹ جانے کی فکر ہے۔

lessons.meaning: Feeling pleased about an achievement or someone you value.
lessons.example: She felt proud of her careful work.
lessons.tip: Use proud of someone or something.
lessons.exampleUrdu: اسے اپنے احتیاط سے کیے گئے کام پر فخر محسوس ہوا۔

lessons.meaning: Unhappy because something was not as good as expected.
lessons.example: He was disappointed with the result but tried again.
lessons.tip: Disappointed concerns an unmet expectation, not every kind of sadness.
lessons.exampleUrdu: وہ نتیجے سے مایوس ہوا، مگر اس نے پھر کوشش کی۔

lessons.meaning: To give someone confidence or support to do something.
lessons.example: We encourage each other to practise English.
lessons.tip: Use encourage someone to do something.
lessons.exampleUrdu: ہم ایک دوسرے کو انگریزی کی مشق کرنے کا حوصلہ دیتے ہیں۔

lessons.meaning: Able to wait or deal with difficulty without becoming angry.
lessons.example: Our teacher is patient with new learners.
lessons.tip: Patient is an adjective here; a patient can also mean a person receiving healthcare.
lessons.exampleUrdu: ہمارے استاد نئے سیکھنے والوں کے ساتھ تحمل سے پیش آتے ہیں۔

title: Solving small problems
goal: Explain a problem and take useful action.

lessons.meaning: To become aware of something by seeing or hearing it.
lessons.example: Did you notice a mistake in my answer?
lessons.tip: Notice means become aware; notify means tell someone formally.
lessons.exampleUrdu: کیا آپ نے میرے جواب میں کوئی غلطی دیکھی؟

lessons.meaning: To make something damaged work properly again.
lessons.example: The mechanic can repair my bicycle today.
lessons.tip: Repair is more specific than change or replace.
lessons.exampleUrdu: مکینک آج میری سائیکل کی مرمت کر سکتا ہے۔

lessons.meaning: To put a different thing in the place of another.
lessons.example: We need to replace the battery in the clock.
lessons.tip: Replace means substitute something, rather than mend the original.
lessons.exampleUrdu: ہمیں گھڑی کی بیٹری بدلنی ہے۔

lessons.meaning: A way of solving a problem.
lessons.example: We worked together to find a solution.
lessons.tip: Use a solution to a problem.
lessons.exampleUrdu: ہم نے مل کر حل تلاش کیا۔

lessons.meaning: Giving attention to avoid mistakes or harm.
lessons.example: Be careful when you cross this busy road.
lessons.tip: Careful describes the person; carefully describes an action.
lessons.exampleUrdu: اس مصروف سڑک کو پار کرتے وقت محتاط رہیں۔

lessons.meaning: Needing attention or action very soon.
lessons.example: This urgent request needs an answer today.
lessons.tip: Urgent concerns time and priority, not necessarily severity.
lessons.exampleUrdu: اس فوری درخواست کا جواب آج دینا ضروری ہے۔

title: Making plans
goal: Set priorities and work towards a realistic goal.

lessons.meaning: Something you want to achieve.
lessons.example: Set a goal you can reach this week.
lessons.tip: A goal is a desired result; a plan describes how to reach it.
lessons.exampleUrdu: ایسا ہدف مقرر کریں جسے آپ اس ہفتے حاصل کر سکیں۔

lessons.meaning: To get ready for an activity or event.
lessons.example: I prepare for each lesson by reading my notes.
lessons.tip: Prepare for an event, or prepare something you will use.
lessons.exampleUrdu: میں اپنے نوٹس پڑھ کر ہر سبق کی تیاری کرتا ہوں۔

lessons.meaning: A plan that shows when activities will happen.
lessons.example: My study schedule includes a short break.
lessons.tip: A schedule organises time; a list need not include times.
lessons.exampleUrdu: میرے مطالعے کے اوقات میں ایک مختصر وقفہ بھی شامل ہے۔

lessons.meaning: Something more important than other things and dealt with first.
lessons.example: Finishing the assignment is my top priority today.
lessons.tip: Priorities can change as needs change.
lessons.exampleUrdu: آج اس کام کو مکمل کرنا میری اولین ترجیح ہے۔

lessons.meaning: To arrange things or activities in a useful order.
lessons.example: I organise my notes by topic.
lessons.tip: Organise is British spelling; organize is also standard.
lessons.exampleUrdu: میں اپنے نوٹس موضوع کے مطابق ترتیب دیتا ہوں۔

lessons.meaning: To finish doing or making something.
lessons.example: Please complete the task before the lesson ends.
lessons.tip: Complete is a verb here; it can also mean whole as an adjective.
lessons.exampleUrdu: براہ کرم سبق ختم ہونے سے پہلے کام مکمل کریں۔

title: Clear conversations
goal: Explain your point and understand another speaker.

lessons.meaning: To make something clear by giving information about it.
lessons.example: Can you explain this idea in simpler words?
lessons.tip: Explain something to someone, not explain someone something.
lessons.exampleUrdu: کیا آپ اس خیال کی وضاحت آسان الفاظ میں کر سکتے ہیں؟

lessons.meaning: To say what a person, place or thing is like.
lessons.example: Describe a place you enjoy visiting.
lessons.tip: Describe gives details; explain often gives reasons or how something works.
lessons.exampleUrdu: کسی ایسی جگہ کا بیان کریں جہاں جانا آپ کو پسند ہے۔

lessons.meaning: To have the same opinion as someone.
lessons.example: I agree with your suggestion about the meeting.
lessons.tip: Agree with a person or view; agree to a proposal or request.
lessons.exampleUrdu: اجلاس کے بارے میں آپ کی تجویز سے میں متفق ہوں۔

lessons.meaning: To offer an idea for someone to consider.
lessons.example: I suggest a change to our study plan.
lessons.tip: Use suggest doing something, rather than suggest someone to do it.
lessons.exampleUrdu: میں ہمارے مطالعے کے منصوبے میں ایک تبدیلی تجویز کرتا ہوں۔

lessons.meaning: To make something easier to understand.
lessons.example: Please clarify the final point in your answer.
lessons.tip: Clarify helps resolve uncertainty or ambiguity.
lessons.exampleUrdu: براہ کرم اپنے جواب کا آخری نکتہ واضح کریں۔

lessons.meaning: To give an answer or reaction.
lessons.example: Please respond to the invitation by Friday.
lessons.tip: Use respond to a person, message or event.
lessons.exampleUrdu: براہ کرم جمعے تک دعوت کا جواب دیں۔

title: Learning effectively
goal: Understand common classroom and learning language.

lessons.meaning: To give most of your attention to something.
lessons.example: Try to focus on one task at a time.
lessons.tip: Use focus on a task or topic.
lessons.exampleUrdu: ایک وقت میں ایک کام پر توجہ دینے کی کوشش کریں۔

lessons.meaning: To look at something again to remember or assess it.
lessons.example: I review my notes the day after each lesson.
lessons.tip: Review can mean study again or assess the quality of something.
lessons.exampleUrdu: میں ہر سبق کے اگلے دن اپنے نوٹس دہراتا ہوں۔

lessons.meaning: Repeated activity intended to improve a skill.
lessons.example: Regular practice helps me remember new words.
lessons.tip: In British English, practice is the noun and practise is the verb.
lessons.exampleUrdu: باقاعدہ مشق سے مجھے نئے الفاظ یاد رکھنے میں مدد ملتی ہے۔

lessons.meaning: Movement towards improvement or a goal.
lessons.example: You can make progress with a little study each day.
lessons.tip: Progress is usually uncountable: make progress, not make a progress.
lessons.exampleUrdu: روزانہ تھوڑا سا مطالعہ کرکے آپ پیش رفت کر سکتے ہیں۔

lessons.meaning: Information about how well something was done and how it could improve.
lessons.example: The teacher gave useful feedback on my paragraph.
lessons.tip: Feedback is normally uncountable.
lessons.exampleUrdu: استاد نے میرے پیراگراف پر مفید اصلاحی رائے دی۔

lessons.meaning: A planned way of achieving a goal.
lessons.example: Testing myself is one learning strategy I use.
lessons.tip: A strategy guides action; a goal states the desired result.
lessons.exampleUrdu: خود سے سوال کرنا سیکھنے کی ایک حکمت عملی ہے جسے میں استعمال کرتا ہوں۔

title: Working together
goal: Take responsibility and collaborate on a task.

lessons.meaning: A piece of work that needs to be done.
lessons.example: We divided the task into three smaller steps.
lessons.tip: A task is a specific piece of work, not an entire career.
lessons.exampleUrdu: ہم نے کام کو تین چھوٹے مرحلوں میں تقسیم کیا۔

lessons.meaning: A duty to deal with something or take care of someone.
lessons.example: Each team member must take responsibility for one task.
lessons.tip: Responsibility may mean a duty or accountability for an action.
lessons.exampleUrdu: ٹیم کے ہر فرد کو ایک کام کی ذمہ داری لینی چاہیے۔

lessons.meaning: To give time, effort, money or ideas to something.
lessons.example: Everyone can contribute to the discussion.
lessons.tip: Use contribute to an activity or result.
lessons.exampleUrdu: ہر شخص گفتگو میں حصہ ڈال سکتا ہے۔

lessons.meaning: To work with others towards a shared purpose.
lessons.example: We cooperate with another class on the project.
lessons.tip: Use cooperate with someone or cooperate on a project.
lessons.exampleUrdu: ہم اس منصوبے پر دوسری جماعت کے ساتھ تعاون کرتے ہیں۔

lessons.meaning: The latest time by which something must be done.
lessons.example: We planned our work carefully to meet the deadline.
lessons.tip: Meeting a deadline means finishing by that time.
lessons.exampleUrdu: ہم نے مقررہ وقت پر کام مکمل کرنے کے لیے احتیاط سے منصوبہ بنایا۔

lessons.meaning: Able to be trusted to do what is expected.
lessons.example: Use a reliable source when you check a fact.
lessons.tip: Reliable describes dependable people, information or equipment.
lessons.exampleUrdu: کسی حقیقت کی تصدیق کرتے وقت قابل اعتماد ماخذ استعمال کریں۔

title: Reading for meaning
goal: Distinguish ideas, facts and supporting details.

lessons.meaning: The surrounding words or situation that help explain meaning.
lessons.example: Read the whole sentence to understand the context.
lessons.tip: Context helps you choose among different senses of a word.
lessons.exampleUrdu: سیاق و سباق سمجھنے کے لیے پورا جملہ پڑھیں۔

lessons.meaning: A small piece of information about something.
lessons.example: Underline each important detail in the passage.
lessons.tip: A detail supports a broader description or main idea.
lessons.exampleUrdu: عبارت میں ہر اہم تفصیل کے نیچے لکیر کھینچیں۔

lessons.meaning: The reason for doing something or the intended result.
lessons.example: The main purpose of the notice is to explain a change.
lessons.tip: Purpose answers why something is done.
lessons.exampleUrdu: اطلاع کا بنیادی مقصد ایک تبدیلی کی وضاحت کرنا ہے۔

lessons.meaning: A belief or judgement that someone holds.
lessons.example: The final sentence expresses a personal opinion.
lessons.tip: An opinion can be supported by evidence but is not automatically a fact.
lessons.exampleUrdu: آخری جملے میں ذاتی رائے بیان ہوئی ہے۔

lessons.meaning: Information or observations that support or challenge a claim.
lessons.example: The writer gives supporting evidence for the claim.
lessons.tip: Evidence is normally uncountable and may vary in strength.
lessons.exampleUrdu: مصنف دعوے کی تائید میں شواہد پیش کرتا ہے۔

lessons.meaning: To reach a conclusion from available information.
lessons.example: We can infer a meaning from the surrounding sentences.
lessons.tip: A reader infers; a speaker or writer may imply.
lessons.exampleUrdu: ہم اردگرد کے جملوں سے معنی اخذ کر سکتے ہیں۔

title: Comparing ideas
goal: Describe similarities, differences and significance.

lessons.meaning: Having features that are alike.
lessons.example: This word is similar to one we learned yesterday.
lessons.tip: Use similar to, rather than similar with.
lessons.exampleUrdu: یہ لفظ اُس لفظ سے ملتا جلتا ہے جو ہم نے کل سیکھا تھا۔

lessons.meaning: To compare things in order to show their differences.
lessons.example: We contrast two views to show how they differ.
lessons.tip: Contrast focuses on differences; compare can include similarities.
lessons.exampleUrdu: ہم فرق واضح کرنے کے لیے دو آرا کا تقابل کرتے ہیں۔

lessons.meaning: An advantage or helpful result.
lessons.example: The main benefit of the new timetable is a longer lunch break.
lessons.tip: A benefit is a positive result, not simply any result.
lessons.exampleUrdu: نئے نظام الاوقات کا بنیادی فائدہ دوپہر کا طویل وقفہ ہے۔

lessons.meaning: A restriction or weakness that reduces what something can do.
lessons.example: The small sample is an important limitation of the study.
lessons.tip: A limitation does not necessarily make a study worthless.
lessons.exampleUrdu: چھوٹا نمونہ اس مطالعے کی ایک اہم حد ہے۔

lessons.meaning: Important or large enough to deserve attention.
lessons.example: There is a significant difference in the two accounts.
lessons.tip: In statistics, significant has a technical meaning distinct from important.
lessons.exampleUrdu: دونوں بیانات میں قابل توجہ فرق ہے۔

lessons.meaning: Another possible choice or way of doing something.
lessons.example: Walking is a practical alternative to taking the bus.
lessons.tip: An alternative is an option, not always the opposite.
lessons.exampleUrdu: بس کے بجائے پیدل جانا ایک قابل عمل متبادل ہے۔

title: Writing with a clear structure
goal: Build a paragraph and connect your ideas.

lessons.meaning: To present a topic or idea for the first time.
lessons.example: Use your first paragraph to introduce the topic.
lessons.tip: Introduce starts discussion; it does not need to explain every detail.
lessons.exampleUrdu: موضوع متعارف کرانے کے لیے اپنا پہلا پیراگراف استعمال کریں۔

lessons.meaning: To make an idea fuller or more detailed.
lessons.example: Use an example to develop the idea in your paragraph.
lessons.tip: Develop can describe ideas, abilities or physical growth.
lessons.exampleUrdu: پیراگراف میں خیال کو مزید واضح کرنے کے لیے مثال دیں۔

lessons.meaning: To provide reasons or evidence for a statement.
lessons.urdu: تائید کرنا؛ دلیل سے تقویت دینا
lessons.example: Use evidence to support your claim.
lessons.tip: Support has other senses, including help or hold something up.
lessons.exampleUrdu: اپنے دعوے کی تائید میں شواہد استعمال کریں۔

lessons.meaning: A word that introduces a contrast with what has just been said.
lessons.example: The plan is useful; however, it needs more time.
lessons.tip: Use punctuation to separate however when it links contrasting statements.
lessons.exampleUrdu: منصوبہ مفید ہے؛ تاہم، اس کے لیے مزید وقت درکار ہے۔

lessons.meaning: For that reason or as a result.
lessons.example: The road was closed; therefore, we took another route.
lessons.tip: Therefore introduces a consequence, not a contrast.
lessons.exampleUrdu: سڑک بند تھی؛ اس لیے ہم نے دوسرا راستہ اختیار کیا۔

lessons.meaning: To end a discussion or reach a judgement after considering information.
lessons.example: We conclude the discussion by summarising the main points.
lessons.tip: Make clear whether conclude means finish or reach a judgement.
lessons.exampleUrdu: ہم بنیادی نکات کا خلاصہ پیش کرکے گفتگو ختم کرتے ہیں۔

title: Questions and research
goal: Understand how a simple investigation is organised.

lessons.meaning: To examine something carefully to discover information.
lessons.example: The students investigate a problem in their local area.
lessons.tip: Investigate is more systematic than simply notice.
lessons.exampleUrdu: طلبہ اپنے علاقے کے ایک مسئلے کی تحقیق کرتے ہیں۔

lessons.meaning: A planned way of doing something.
lessons.example: The report explains the research method clearly.
lessons.tip: A method states how work is carried out.
lessons.exampleUrdu: رپورٹ میں تحقیق کے طریقے کی واضح وضاحت دی گئی ہے۔

lessons.meaning: A smaller group or amount selected from a larger one for study.
lessons.example: The survey used a small sample of local residents.
lessons.tip: A sample may not represent the whole population well.
lessons.exampleUrdu: سروے میں مقامی باشندوں کا ایک چھوٹا نمونہ لیا گیا۔

lessons.meaning: To watch or examine something carefully.
lessons.example: We observe a change in the plant each day.
lessons.tip: Observation records what is noticed; interpretation explains it.
lessons.exampleUrdu: ہم ہر روز پودے میں تبدیلی کا مشاہدہ کرتے ہیں۔

lessons.meaning: To examine parts of something to understand how they relate.
lessons.example: We analyse the text before we write our response.
lessons.tip: Analyse is British spelling; analyze is American spelling.
lessons.exampleUrdu: ہم اپنا جواب لکھنے سے پہلے متن کا تجزیہ کرتے ہیں۔

lessons.meaning: To explain or decide the meaning of something.
lessons.urdu: معنی کی وضاحت کرنا؛ تعبیر کرنا
lessons.example: Researchers interpret a result using the available evidence.
lessons.tip: Different interpretations need to be assessed against evidence.
lessons.exampleUrdu: محققین دستیاب شواہد کی مدد سے نتیجے کی تعبیر کرتے ہیں۔

title: Evaluating an argument
goal: Assess claims without confusing confidence with evidence.

lessons.meaning: A statement that someone says is true, which may need evidence.
lessons.example: The writer uses figures to support the claim.
lessons.tip: A claim needs evaluation; it is not necessarily false.
lessons.exampleUrdu: مصنف دعوے کی تائید کے لیے اعداد استعمال کرتا ہے۔

lessons.meaning: Something accepted as true without being established in that discussion.
lessons.example: The underlying assumption is that every student has internet access.
lessons.tip: Identify an assumption before relying on it.
lessons.exampleUrdu: بنیادی مفروضہ یہ ہے کہ ہر طالب علم کو انٹرنیٹ کی سہولت حاصل ہے۔

lessons.meaning: To give reasons showing why a view or action is reasonable.
lessons.example: The school must justify its decision to change the timetable.
lessons.tip: Justify means give reasons, not merely repeat a decision.
lessons.exampleUrdu: اسکول کو نظام الاوقات بدلنے کے فیصلے کی وجوہ پیش کرنی چاہییں۔

lessons.meaning: Well founded or acceptable under the relevant rules or reasoning.
lessons.example: Lack of transport is a valid reason for requesting a later start.
lessons.tip: The technical meaning of valid depends on the field.
lessons.exampleUrdu: ٹرانسپورٹ کا نہ ہونا تاخیر سے آغاز کی درخواست کے لیے معقول وجہ ہے۔

lessons.meaning: A tendency that unfairly favours one view, person or group.
lessons.example: We need to recognise bias when we evaluate a source.
lessons.tip: Bias can be unintended as well as deliberate.
lessons.exampleUrdu: کسی ماخذ کا جائزہ لیتے وقت ہمیں جانبداری پہچاننی چاہیے۔

lessons.meaning: To judge the quality, value or effectiveness of something using criteria.
lessons.urdu: جانچنا؛ قدر و معیار کا جائزہ لینا
lessons.example: We evaluate the evidence before accepting the conclusion.
lessons.tip: Evaluation includes a judgement; description alone does not.
lessons.exampleUrdu: نتیجہ قبول کرنے سے پہلے ہم شواہد کا جائزہ لیتے ہیں۔

title: Precision and uncertainty
goal: Make careful statements about evidence and certainty.

lessons.meaning: Correct and free from significant mistakes.
lessons.example: Check that the report contains accurate information.
lessons.tip: Accuracy concerns correctness; precision concerns exactness or consistency.
lessons.exampleUrdu: دیکھیں کہ رپورٹ کی معلومات درست ہیں۔

lessons.meaning: Exact and clearly defined.
lessons.example: Give a precise description of where the problem occurred.
lessons.tip: A precise measurement is not necessarily accurate.
lessons.exampleUrdu: واضح طور پر بتائیں کہ مسئلہ کہاں پیش آیا۔

lessons.meaning: Not changing in a contradictory way across occasions or parts.
lessons.example: The repeated tests produced consistent results.
lessons.tip: Consistent results can still contain a repeated error.
lessons.exampleUrdu: بار بار کیے گئے تجربات سے یکساں نتائج حاصل ہوئے۔

lessons.meaning: Close to the exact value, but not completely exact.
lessons.example: The approximate cost is two thousand rupees.
lessons.tip: Make clear when a number is an estimate.
lessons.exampleUrdu: تقریبی لاگت دو ہزار روپے ہے۔

lessons.meaning: Not final or certain and open to change.
lessons.example: This tentative conclusion needs further evidence.
lessons.tip: Tentative signals caution rather than a settled judgement.
lessons.exampleUrdu: اس غیر حتمی نتیجے کے لیے مزید شواہد درکار ہیں۔

lessons.meaning: Seeming reasonable or possible on the available information.
lessons.example: The writer offers a plausible explanation for the delay.
lessons.tip: Plausible does not mean proven true.
lessons.exampleUrdu: مصنف تاخیر کی ایک قرین قیاس وجہ پیش کرتا ہے۔

title: Change and consequences
goal: Discuss causes, outcomes and complex change.

lessons.meaning: A strong effect that something has on someone or something.
lessons.example: The new library had a lasting impact on the community.
lessons.tip: Use impact on someone or something.
lessons.exampleUrdu: نئے کتب خانے نے مقامی آبادی پر دیرپا اثر ڈالا۔

lessons.meaning: A result of an action or event.
lessons.example: An unexpected consequence was a rise in travel costs.
lessons.tip: A consequence can be positive or negative.
lessons.exampleUrdu: ایک غیر متوقع نتیجہ سفر کے اخراجات میں اضافہ تھا۔

lessons.meaning: Something that contributes to a situation or result.
lessons.example: Access to transport is an important factor in attendance.
lessons.tip: A contributing factor need not be the only cause.
lessons.exampleUrdu: ٹرانسپورٹ کی سہولت حاضری کا ایک اہم عامل ہے۔

lessons.meaning: To change to suit new conditions.
lessons.example: Students adapt to a new timetable over time.
lessons.tip: Adapt to new conditions; adapt something for a purpose.
lessons.exampleUrdu: وقت کے ساتھ طلبہ نئے نظام الاوقات کے مطابق ڈھل جاتے ہیں۔

lessons.meaning: To keep something going over a period of time.
lessons.example: Small daily sessions can help sustain progress.
lessons.tip: Sustain means maintain, not merely begin.
lessons.exampleUrdu: روزانہ مختصر مشق پیش رفت برقرار رکھنے میں مدد دے سکتی ہے۔

lessons.meaning: To make the seriousness or harmful effects of something smaller.
lessons.example: Better drainage can mitigate the risk of flooding.
lessons.tip: Mitigate reduces harm; it does not necessarily remove the cause.
lessons.exampleUrdu: بہتر نکاسیِ آب سے سیلاب کا خطرہ کم کیا جا سکتا ہے۔

title: Society and public decisions
goal: Read common language used in public affairs.

lessons.meaning: A plan or set of principles used to guide decisions.
lessons.example: The school policy explains how absences are recorded.
lessons.tip: Identify whose policy you mean and what it covers.
lessons.exampleUrdu: اسکول کی پالیسی میں غیر حاضری کا اندراج کرنے کا طریقہ بتایا گیا ہے۔

lessons.meaning: The ability or opportunity to reach or use something.
lessons.example: Every student needs access to learning materials.
lessons.tip: Use access to, rather than access of.
lessons.exampleUrdu: ہر طالب علم کو تعلیمی مواد تک رسائی چاہیے۔

lessons.meaning: Fairness that takes differing needs or circumstances into account.
lessons.example: Providing extra support can promote equity in education.
lessons.tip: In education, equity and identical treatment are not always the same.
lessons.exampleUrdu: اضافی مدد فراہم کرکے تعلیم میں انصاف کو فروغ دیا جا سکتا ہے۔

lessons.meaning: The obligation to explain decisions and accept responsibility for them.
lessons.example: Clear records support public accountability.
lessons.tip: Accountability involves being answerable, not simply being busy.
lessons.exampleUrdu: واضح ریکارڈ عوامی جواب دہی میں مدد دیتا ہے۔

lessons.meaning: To put a plan, policy or decision into action.
lessons.example: The team will implement the plan next month.
lessons.tip: A plan may be announced before it is implemented.
lessons.exampleUrdu: ٹیم اگلے مہینے منصوبے پر عمل کرے گی۔

lessons.meaning: Able to continue over time without exhausting essential resources or support.
lessons.example: The school needs a sustainable approach to funding.
lessons.tip: Explain what makes an activity sustainable in its context.
lessons.exampleUrdu: اسکول کو مالی وسائل کے لیے پائیدار طریقہ درکار ہے۔

title: Nuance in demanding texts
goal: Understand careful distinctions in formal writing.

lessons.meaning: Having more than one possible meaning or interpretation.
lessons.urdu: مبہم؛ ایک سے زیادہ معنی رکھنے والا
lessons.example: The ambiguous statement could be understood in two ways.
lessons.tip: Ambiguous concerns multiple interpretations; vague concerns lack of detail.
lessons.exampleUrdu: مبہم بیان کو دو طرح سے سمجھا جا سکتا ہے۔

lessons.meaning: Suggested or understood without being stated directly.
lessons.urdu: غیر صریح؛ ضمنی طور پر موجود
lessons.example: The story contains an implicit message about responsibility.
lessons.tip: Implicit contrasts with explicit, which is directly stated.
lessons.exampleUrdu: کہانی میں ذمہ داری کے بارے میں ایک ضمنی پیغام موجود ہے۔

lessons.meaning: Stated clearly and directly.
lessons.example: The teacher gave an explicit instruction to cite the source.
lessons.tip: Explicit describes direct expression, not necessarily detailed expression.
lessons.exampleUrdu: استاد نے ماخذ کا حوالہ دینے کی واضح ہدایت دی۔

lessons.meaning: Connected and organised in a way that makes sense.
lessons.example: Each paragraph contributes to a coherent argument.
lessons.tip: Coherence concerns how ideas fit together.
lessons.exampleUrdu: ہر پیراگراف ایک مربوط استدلال میں اپنا حصہ ڈالتا ہے۔

lessons.meaning: Not obvious and requiring careful attention to notice.
lessons.example: There is a subtle difference between the two expressions.
lessons.tip: Subtle does not mean unimportant.
lessons.exampleUrdu: دونوں تعبیرات میں ایک باریک فرق ہے۔

lessons.meaning: To examine something very carefully.
lessons.example: Researchers scrutinise the evidence before publishing a claim.
lessons.tip: Scrutinise is British spelling; scrutinize is American spelling.
lessons.exampleUrdu: محققین دعویٰ شائع کرنے سے پہلے شواہد کا باریک بینی سے جائزہ لیتے ہیں۔

title: From evidence to insight
goal: Bring ideas together and recognise their limits.

lessons.meaning: To provide additional evidence that supports a statement.
lessons.example: A second witness can corroborate the account.
lessons.tip: Corroboration adds support but does not guarantee complete certainty.
lessons.exampleUrdu: دوسرا گواہ بیان کی مزید تائید کر سکتا ہے۔

lessons.meaning: Based on observation or experience rather than theory alone.
lessons.example: The study provides empirical evidence for its conclusion.
lessons.tip: Empirical concerns the source of evidence, not its quality by itself.
lessons.exampleUrdu: مطالعے میں نتیجے کی تائید کے لیے مشاہداتی شواہد پیش کیے گئے ہیں۔

lessons.meaning: To combine information or ideas into a connected whole.
lessons.urdu: معلومات یکجا کرکے مربوط نتیجہ پیش کرنا
lessons.example: The review aims to synthesise findings from several studies.
lessons.tip: Synthesis connects sources rather than merely listing summaries.
lessons.exampleUrdu: جائزے کا مقصد کئی مطالعات کے نتائج یکجا کرکے مربوط صورت میں پیش کرنا ہے۔

lessons.meaning: A difference between things that are expected to agree.
lessons.example: The team must explain the discrepancy between the two totals.
lessons.tip: A discrepancy signals a mismatch that needs checking.
lessons.exampleUrdu: ٹیم کو دونوں مجموعوں کے فرق کی وضاحت کرنی چاہیے۔

lessons.meaning: Existing as a natural or essential part of something.
lessons.example: The method has an inherent limitation that cannot be removed easily.
lessons.tip: Inherent means built into something, not acquired later.
lessons.exampleUrdu: اس طریقے میں ایک بنیادی حد ہے جسے آسانی سے دور نہیں کیا جا سکتا۔

lessons.meaning: A small but meaningful difference in meaning, expression or judgement.
lessons.urdu: معنی یا اظہار کا باریک فرق
lessons.example: Careful reading helps us notice a nuance in the writer's tone.
lessons.tip: A nuance adds a fine distinction, rather than an entirely different topic.
lessons.exampleUrdu: غور سے پڑھنے سے ہمیں مصنف کے لہجے کا باریک فرق سمجھنے میں مدد ملتی ہے۔
